name: Mitsudomoecchi ~Tengoku to Jigoku!! Sugisaki Wonderland no Eroi Wana~
original_name: みつどもえっち  ～天国と地獄！！　杉崎ワンダーランドのエロい罠～
source:
Erotic trouble befalls the triplets at the amusement park's opening! 

The classroom was the same as usual and everyone was making noise as they pleased. Chiba was deep in thought when she overheard Sugisaki's boastful stories.

"Dad created 'Sugisaki Wonderland' for the children♪ You want to go, right? You want to go, right?...If you insist, I don't mind taking you there, okay?" An interesting thought flashed through Chiba's mind.

The next Sunday, at Sugisaki's invitation, the whole class decided to visit Sugisaki Wonderland, not knowing what kind of traps awaited them...

 [Translated from [url=http://www.b-o-m.jp/gmlist/006_mitsudomoetch/index.html]Official site[/url].]
translation:
游乐园开幕时，三胞胎遭遇色情麻烦！

教室里和往常一样，大家都在大声喧哗。听到杉崎的夸夸其谈，千叶陷入了沉思。

“爸爸为孩子们创造了“杉崎仙境”♪你想去对吧？你想去对吧？……如果你坚持的话，我不介意带你去，好吗？”千叶脑海中闪过一个有趣的念头。

接下来的周日，在杉崎的邀请下，全班同学决定前往杉崎仙境，不知道会有什么样的陷阱等待着他们……
